_about: Constructed companies and pages for the company site finder (company-site-apply task, rule R1). No real posting is copied. Each case gives the job, the search results per query (in order), the fetched pages (url to [page title, main text]; a missing url means the fetch failed), and the expected result. Labels were written before the finder code.
